blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Provincial Veterinary Office (PVO) has confirmed African Swine Fever (ASF) cases in Samboan, prompting containment measures and expanded surveillance across the southern Cebu municipality. PVO head Dr. Mary Rose Vincoy said positive samples were detected in Barangay Colase in the southwestern Cebu town early November 2026, affecting both semi-commercial pig farms and backyard raisers. The investigation followed a request from the local government unit (LGU) for the PVO to assess reports of suspected ASF infections in the area.
